steps:
Invalid input, and it crashes the compiler four times: use an IDE you can restart.
1. Unzip embed-package-without-packages-folder.zip (pack writes it; the issue has the project and the packages as two attachments), which holds embed-package-without-packages-folder.twinproj, DocProbePkg-nopackages.twinpack, made by "<IDE>\bin\twinBASIC_win32.exe" import from package/DocProbePkg, a tree that has no Packages folder, and DocProbePkg-control.twinpack. Open the project.
2. Project Settings > References > Available Packages > Import from file... DocProbePkg-nopackages.twinpack; tick the package; Apply.
3. See, in the DEBUG CONSOLE, [PROJECT] twinBASIC project saving to disk [DONE], then restarting from FILE four times about two seconds apart, and the IDE reports "Compiler crash loop detected. Restarting in SAFE mode."
Control: the same steps with DocProbePkg-control.twinpack (made by scripts/impexp.mjs, which adds the empty Packages, ImportedTypeLibraries and Miscellaneous folders): the compiler restarts once and runs the package.
Measured on BETA 995 earlier this session with the packages lane's host and package, with the package's three empty folders varied one at a time; `ide-test.bat` now packs the package with impexp.mjs, which adds the folders, so no lane reproduces the crash today.
